status: request specification only; no institutional records received
purpose: Establish whether a same-perimeter allocation and credit audit is possible before choosing an empirical model or evaluating outcomes

contract: fixed book roster and ownership boundary
approved eligible coalitions or explicit normative-only label
current allocation rule and its budget unit
credit permissions and budget in the SAME unit, time basis and perimeter as the allocation
scenario_metadata: historical scenario date or simulated/stress label
allocation_baseline: ability/permission to evaluate the incumbent rule under the common risk/scenario specification
existing internal credits and transfer ledger
internal_transfer_reconciliation: opaque transfer/hedge mapping IDs if needed, without client identities
sending and receiving internal book IDs and ownership timing
internal versus external leg classification or signed aggregate reconciliation attestation
matched offset/netting treatment and no duplicated benefit
reconciliation: each book valued on the same joint scenarios and date
weights sum to one for probabilistic functionals
post-transfer risk ownership reconciles without counting an internal hedge twice
sum of book scenario losses equals perimeter scenario loss if additivity is claimed
existing charges reconcile to the same approved budget or differences are explicitly separated
a rule-only comparison evaluates incumbent and candidates with the SAME risk functional, model/scenario version, valuation basis and cutoff; otherwise it is not identified
cross-book netting/default/collateral effects have an approved coalition valuation rule if nonadditive

later_empirical_evaluation: untouched or prospective outcome period chosen before fitting the candidate
realized or appropriately hypothetical P&L aligned with the risk forecast; carry/trading effects separated
all decision-time forecast vintages and information availability
roster and mandate changes with predetermined handling
chosen decision outcomes and implementation costs
sponsor-approved materiality threshold and sample-size/dependence justification
not_sufficient_alone: Treasury yield series plus invented books
sensitive_data_handling: No data transmission authorized by this specification. Avoid client identities/account numbers. Prefer de-identified book IDs or an institution-run calculation; agree the actual recipient and permissions before any transfer.
gate: Actual contract plus compatible joint risks plus a comparable current baseline plus an identifiable decision. Otherwise report missing inputs and stop.
